infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Parking+ uses your location to find which emirate you parked in and to notice Salik gates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Always so Parking+ can remind you to pay for parking and warn you about Salik balance even when the app is closed. Your location never leaves your phone.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Always so Parking+ can remind you to pay for parking and warn you about Salik balance even when the app is closed. Your location never leaves your phone.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Always so Parking+ can remind you to pay for parking and warn you about Salik balance even when the app is closed. Your location never leaves your phone.

plugins.motionPermission: Parking+ uses your steps to tell when you got out of the car, so it asks about parking only when you have really parked. Nothing leaves your phone.
